Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: لآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيْمُ الْكَرِيْمُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous

Arabic text: لآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent
Glory be to Allah, Lord of the seven heavens
And Lord of the seven earths

Arabic text: وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ
Translation: And whatever is in them and whatever is between them

Arabic text: وَ مَا فَوْقَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ
Translation: And whatever is above them and whatever is beneath them
Lord of the Magnificent Throne
And peace be upon the Messengers
And all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure family
I seek forgiveness from Allah, my Lord, and I turn to Him in repentance
O Allah, forgive [Name]
O Allah, forgive the believing men and women

Arabic text: اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِيْ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
Translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, beside whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting
For all my oppression and crimes
And my excesses against myself
And I turn to Him in repentance

Arabic text: هٰذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
Translation: This is the position of one who seeks Your protection from the Fire
Pardon (me)

Arabic text: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَ ارْحَمْنِيْ وَ تُبْ عَلَيَّ
Translation: My Lord, forgive me and have mercy on me and accept my repentance
Verily, You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Merciful
